course_name_en: Materials Science for Mechanical Engineering/Process Engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to understand basic knowledge about the state and properties of materials and to transfer them to engineering applications.
Students can explain mechanical and functional properties of materials from their microscopic and submicroscopic structural principles and purposefully propose property changes.
The subject primarily imparts professional competence.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the properties of metals: Structure, bonding types and structure
Testing of metallic materials: Destructive testing methods
Adjustment of service properties of iron-based materials: Iron-carbon diagram
